goal: Close the receipt-binding and approval-digest findings of the external static review of b4a0ed8 without disturbing the in-flight G0/G1 demonstration.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Receipts carry the real dsh headless session id and its event-log head digest; the business effect log moves to its own field.
effective_composition_sha256 digests the patch, skill, workflow-tools plugin tree, and container image; receipts record the image digest.
evaluateBranch rejects receipts whose task_handle or grader_receipt_sha256 does not match the graded task/verdict; branchStats counts only provenance-valid evaluations.
The approval manifest digest binds provider, model, runner, fault profile, container image, agent-visible task contents, policy, skill, workflow-tools source, and exact prompts.
The driver recovers once from a docker transport failure: kill lingering containers, reseed service state, relaunch Docker Desktop when the daemon is down.
Repository-wide gate passes after the changes.

outcome.summary: Receipts now bind the actual dsh session and event log, split the business effect log into its own field, and digest the full effective composition; branch evaluations admit only receipts matching the graded task and verdict, and provenance-invalid evaluations no longer count in branch stats; the approval manifest binds the full transmission. Focused tests and the full gate pass.

what_worked: Additive optional schema fields kept every historical receipt valid.
The dsh headless runner persists sessions under a batch-local DSH_HOME, making session capture deterministic per attempt.
what_failed: One earlier full-gate run failed only because the concurrently running demo had temporarily swapped the benchmark skill; re-run after restore passed.

evidence.summary: tests/branch.test.ts and tests/execution-receipt.test.ts pass, including new task-handle and grader-receipt mismatch rejections and receipt-bound stats.
Receipt schema accepts the new optional fields; historical fixtures still validate.
Typecheck passes over the driver changes (manifest, session capture, resilience).
manifestDigest now digests provider, model, runner, faults, container image, policy, skill, workflow-tools tree, agent-visible tasks, and prompts.
pnpm run check passed after the demo skill was restored.

uncertainty.statement: The approval manifest does not yet bind the rendered composition patch text itself (it binds the patch inputs plus the tools source).
uncertainty.resolution: Follow-up: include the rendered patch digest in the manifest before the next decision issuance.

uncertainty.statement: Physical oracle isolation (three-container topology) and the harness/business outcome split remain open review items deferred to avoid confounding the running demonstration.
uncertainty.resolution: Land after the demo: grader/tool semantic changes bump GRADER_VERSION and require a rebaseline decision.
